editorial.bearCase: QQQ reverses below $715–716 and weakens toward $701.16, particularly if SOX leadership fades or the 10-year yield remains above 5.05%.
editorial.watchNext: October 28 Federal Reserve decision and Microsoft/Alphabet earnings; October 29 GDP/PCE and Amazon earnings. Verify event timing against official calendars before treating scheduled releases as confirmed.
